The closest textual relationship is with the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, which incorporates large segments of the narrative (55 matches, including an extended alignment across §§5.1–21.4), alongside ten matching passages in the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. The poem also shares standard narrative and formulaic blocks with several other apadānas of nuns, including the *Kuṇḍalakesātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 21, §§13.1–17.4), the *Nandātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 25), and the *Khemātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 18), as well as various *Thera-apadāna* texts [DharmaNexus].
